boundary: Counts preserve sealed, external, and current workflow negatives; a later pass never converts a failure into a pass.

x1_operational.failed: The first bounded memory-registry ripgrep search timed out before returning attributable results.
x1_operational.recovery: Use a literal-path Select-String query with a longer bound and a bounded result projection.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer literal-path bounded registry reads when the memory file is cold.

x1_operational.failed: A receipt inventory assumed a validation/evidence-build-receipt path that is not committed and produced a Git fatal for that candidate.
x1_operational.recovery: Inventory exact phase filenames first, then read evidence/evidence-build-receipt.json.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Resolve receipt paths from the committed tree before projecting their schemas.

x1_operational.failed: The first read-only manifest audit overclaimed x1 delta and owner coverage by using guessed domains, so those two coverage assertions earned zero credit.
x1_operational.recovery: Read the committed manifest builder and apply its commit-local replay and exact owner-path semantics.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Inspect the generating validator before asserting manifest coverage beyond blob, byte, and digest replay.

x1_operational.failed: A combined D-drive, name, branch, and tool-version preflight timed out without complete attributable output.
x1_operational.recovery: Split drive, path, branch, task-title, and version checks into scalar probes.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Use one cold subsystem per preflight command.

x1_operational.failed: The first Get-PSDrive free-space probe timed out without a result.
x1_operational.recovery: Use a bounded System.IO.DriveInfo probe and verify the exact D drive.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer DriveInfo for a single local-volume capacity check.

x1_operational.failed: A full-tree Git name search timed out before proving uniqueness.
x1_operational.recovery: Use the current task-title registry plus exact branch and worktree absence checks for the full relational name.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not use an unbounded repository-content search as the identity uniqueness gate.

x1_operational.failed: A combined Git, Python, and Node version command timed out after returning only Git.
x1_operational.recovery: Verify each required version with its own bounded scalar command.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Keep cold tool startup probes separate.

x1_operational.failed: The first task-list call requested a limit above the supported maximum and was rejected.
x1_operational.recovery: Use the live schema maximum and reread the bounded current registry.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Inspect the supported task-list limit before supplying it.

x1_operational.failed: The additive worktree wrapper timed out while Git continued the authorized checkout.
x1_operational.recovery: Wait for Git to finish, then audit exact path, registration, branch, head, clean state, processes, and locks before any retry.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Never retry a timed-out mutating Git command before a complete state audit.

x1_operational.failed: The first combined path, branch, head, and status audit timed out while checkout processes were still active.
x1_operational.recovery: Separate process completion from path, registration, head, lock, and clean-state probes.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not combine worktree inspection with status while the creating Git process is active.

x1_operational.failed: The first PowerShell Get-Process Git audit timed out without attributable output.
x1_operational.recovery: Use the bounded operating-system task listing for process presence, then recheck after completion.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Prefer the simpler process surface when PowerShell process enumeration is cold.

x1_operational.failed: The first post-checkout status wrapper timed out while its Git child continued and produced no attributable clean-state result.
x1_operational.recovery: Wait for the child to finish and run one longer bounded porcelain-status probe.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Treat timed-out status wrappers as zero credit and verify no lingering process before retry.

x1_operational.failed: The first 1,750-row semantic-novelty dry run found six proposal titles at or above the preregistered token-Jaccard threshold, so the candidate set earned zero novelty credit.
x1_operational.recovery: Rewrite the colliding mechanisms and rerun the complete read-only comparison before building the frozen packet.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Do not relax a preregistered novelty threshold to rescue templated wording.

x1_operational.failed: The first diagnostic projection of near-neighbour titles failed when the default console encoding could not emit a Māori character, so that projection earned zero diagnostic credit.
x1_operational.recovery: Set the Python input and output encoding explicitly to UTF-8 and repeat only the bounded diagnostic projection.
x1_operational.recurrence_guard: Force UTF-8 for bounded projections that may contain non-ASCII relational or cultural language.
